title: fastProject 4.11.7 Released
author: Mark Edmonds
content:
General

  • Can now select one of 5 different highlights colors (Yellow, Blue, Gray, Orange & Green) and the ability to name them. You also have the option to show today’s or all Highlighted tasks by color.

Can now select one of 5 different highlights colors (Yellow, Blue, Gray, Orange & Green) and the ability to name them. You also have the option to show today’s or all Highlighted tasks by color.

  • Can now expand multiple summary tasks, optionally hiding the completed tasks and a new option to only show the expanded summary tasks (while hiding everything else).

Can now expand multiple summary tasks, optionally hiding the completed tasks and a new option to only show the expanded summary tasks (while hiding everything else).

  • Add the ability to ad a Target Date when breaking down a task

Add the ability to ad a Target Date when breaking down a task

  • Estimated Durations can now be used. To use, goto Options > General > Allow Estimated Durations

Estimated Durations can now be used. To use, goto Options > General > Allow Estimated Durations

  • Prefix not added to Touchpoints, Checkpoints and Deliverables

Prefix not added to Touchpoints, Checkpoints and Deliverables

Refresh - Roll-up

  • After a roll-up, if the Start and Finish dates do not match, the number of days difference is now reported.

After a roll-up, if the Start and Finish dates do not match, the number of days difference is now reported.

  • Roll-up now automatically corrects when a micro-schedule has non-working time (and the macro-schedule doesn’t). It is possible date constraints are added to the Macro to align the dates in the Micro when the start date would occur on a weekend. To overcome this, the date constant is removed and the task duration if extended so the Finish dates align.

Roll-up now automatically corrects when a micro-schedule has non-working time (and the macro-schedule doesn’t). It is possible date constraints are added to the Macro to align the dates in the Micro when the start date would occur on a weekend. To overcome this, the date constant is removed and the task duration if extended so the Finish dates align.

  • Improve circular dependency checking and reporting

Improve circular dependency checking and reporting

  • Fixed bug where dates rolled-up were not the same if negative lags were used and the micro project was on a different calendar to the macro.

Fixed bug where dates rolled-up were not the same if negative lags were used and the micro project was on a different calendar to the macro.

Analyzer

  • Added improved auto-fix for tasks updated in the future

Added improved auto-fix for tasks updated in the future

Wigglechart

  • Fixed inconsistency in gap between Wigglechart and Dashboard

Fixed inconsistency in gap between Wigglechart and Dashboard

Inspector

  • Critical Path Analysis now only exports Action items with an Owner (general notes are now ignored)

Critical Path Analysis now only exports Action items with an Owner (general notes are now ignored)

  • Added ability to show All Predecessors including completed

Added ability to show All Predecessors including completed

  • Added Show Inactivated and Activate All options under the Inactivate dropdown

Added Show Inactivated and Activate All options under the Inactivate dropdown

Report

  • Under Late Simulator, added ability to set Deadlines on selected Targets

Under Late Simulator, added ability to set Deadlines on selected Targets

FTTM Dashboard

  • Added a check to check for duplicate Wigglecharts in the Import file

Added a check to check for duplicate Wigglecharts in the Import file
